opening.argument: The video pairs a $1,500 Chipotle gift card offer with a direct instruction to leave the video and follow a link in the description to claim it. The title advertises the high-value reward, the description repeats the chance to win and supplies an external destination, and the final screen tells viewers to use that link to claim the free card. That combination makes the reward the reason to follow the link. The intervening Chipotle menu slides do not establish that the offer is official. Nor does the available material show that anyone submitted information or money, or that a gift card was delivered.
